page.title: Shipments
page.description: Shipments assigned to your agency for pickup and delivery
page.searchLabel: Search by order #, customer, product, or tracking #
page.searchHint: Keep typing — search needs at least {{count}} characters.
page.filterDescription: Filters apply across every page of your shipments.
page.emptyNoShipments: No shipments in this category yet

table.trackAgent: Track this agent on the live map

actions.needsAcceptedOffer: An agent must accept the offer first

autoAssign.label: Auto-assign
autoAssign.tooltip: When on, each newly-dispatched shipment starts an auto-assignment broadcast: the nearest eligible agent is offered it, then the next-nearest every couple of minutes while earlier offers still stand. First to accept wins. If nobody takes it after two rounds, you're told and can assign manually.

reject.title: Reject shipment
reject.description: Decline this assignment before pickup. The vendor is notified with your reason so they can reroute it to another agency.
reject.messagePlaceholderRequired: Explain why you're rejecting this shipment…
reject.messagePlaceholderOptional: Add any details for the vendor…

assignment.title: Agent Assignment
assignment.codHint: Cash-on-delivery shipments need an agent to accept before pickup — they hold the cash and the offer is gated on their cash-risk profile.
assignment.codHintAmount: Whoever accepts will be holding {{amount}} in cash — the offer is gated on their cash-risk profile and re-checked when they accept.
assignment.broadcastExplainer: Agents are being offered this shipment nearest-first, one every couple of minutes, with earlier offers left standing — the first to accept gets it. If nobody accepts after two rounds you'll be notified so you can assign manually. Stopping withdraws every live offer.
assignment.autoAssignStarted: Searching — offered to the nearest agent first.
assignment.offersWithdrawn: Offers withdrawn — the shipment is back in your queue.
assignment.handoverInProgress: A handover is in progress — the replacement agent has been offered the shipment.
assignment.notOfferable: No agent can be offered in this shipment's current state.
assignment.handoverFallback: Fallback location — original point could not be resolved.
assignment.candidatesEmptyHint: Agents are left out silently when they are at capacity, paused, or outside this delivery’s area.
assignment.candidatesEmptyCodHint: For a cash-on-delivery run, agents are also left out silently when their cash limit is too low — a new contract starts at zero, which removes the agent from every COD list until you raise it.

reassignDialog.title: Reassign shipment
reassignDialog.description: Release the current agent and offer this shipment to a replacement. This is an audited action.
reassignDialog.agentRequiredHint: The parcel has left the agency, so you must name the replacement.
reassignDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Agent's bike broke down on Rue Joffre
reassignDialog.overrideHint: Leave blank to use the automatic handover point (the previous agent's last known location, the original pickup, or your HQ — depending on the shipment's status).
reassignDialog.success: Shipment released and offered to the replacement.

money.codSnapshotHint: Cash the agent takes from the customer at the door.
money.codProjectedHint: Nobody has taken this delivery yet, so this is a projection of the cash due at the door — item prices × quantity. It's locked in the moment an agent accepts.
money.codProjectedCaption: Projected — no agent has taken this yet
money.prepaidCaption: Paid online — nothing to collect at the door.
money.estimateCaveat: An estimate: the agent's split is read again when the money is actually paid out, so changing their contract before delivery changes this.
money.orderValue: Order value {{amount}} — the whole order, which can split across several shipments and agencies.

unavailable.no_agent: Your net can't be quoted until an agent accepts — their contracted cut comes out of the delivery fee, so any figure shown now would only drop once somebody takes it.
unavailable.no_agency_policy: Your delivery pricing isn't configured, so there's no fee to divide.

detail.deliveryProofNone: No proof photo was recorded for this delivery.

review.title: Rate this delivery
review.explainer: This rates the agent who carried the parcel and feeds their trust score. It does not affect your own agency rating, which comes from your customers.
review.prosePending: Because you have written something, this will be checked by a moderator before it counts. A rating on its own counts straight away.
review.submittedHeld: Submitted — a moderator will review your comments before it counts.
